00007| /// The command a prompt is carried out by, driven to the end of its plan.
00008| ///
00009| /// A command that changes the workspace is not issued once: since issue #944 it
00010| /// is planned as the verified recipe its seed intent declares, so the first tool
00011| /// call for *"copy a.txt to b.txt"* is `test -e a.txt` and the copy itself comes
00012| /// three steps later. This helper therefore drives the plan the way a client
00013| /// would — reporting each step as having succeeded — and returns the one step
00014| /// that is a recipe of its own, which is exactly the mutating action. For every
00015| /// read-only command the plan is a single step and that step is the answer, so
00016| /// the question this helper asks is unchanged.
00017| fn shell_command(prompt: &str) -> Option<String> {
00018|     let mut messages = vec![ChatMessage::user(prompt)];
00019|     let mut commands: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
00020|     while commands.len() <= MAX_PLAN_STEPS {
00021|         let Some(AgenticPlan::ToolCalls(calls)) = plan_chat_step(&messages, &["exec_command"])
00022|         else {
00023|             break;
00024|         };
00025|         let call = calls.first()?;
00026|         let arguments: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&call.arguments).unwrap();
00027|         let command = arguments["command"].as_str()?.to_owned();
00028|         let id = format!("call_{}", messages.len());
00029|         messages.push(ChatMessage::assistant_tool_calls(vec![ToolCall::function(
00030|             id.clone(),
00031|             call.tool.clone(),
00032|             call.arguments.clone(),
00033|         )]));
00034|         messages.push(ChatMessage::tool_result(
00035|             id,
00036|             &call.tool,
00037|             format!("Command: {command}\nOutput: (empty)\nExit Code: 0"),
00038|         ));
00039|         commands.push(command);
00040|     }
00041|     commands
00042|         .iter()
00043|         .find(|command| verified_recipe(command).is_some())
00044|         .or_else(|| commands.first())
00045|         .cloned()
00046| }
00047| 
00048| /// A plan longer than this is a runaway, not an answer; the longest recipe the
00049| /// seed declares is six steps.
00050| const MAX_PLAN_STEPS: usize = 12;
